highlights:
._ The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) will stage planned flight cancellations over seven days before reaching a full 10pc reduction at key airports. A 4pc reduction in operations will take effect today at 40 high-traffic airports across the US before ramping up to 6pc by 11 November, 8pc by 13 November and 10pc by 14 November, according to the US Department of Transportation. Airlines will be allowed to use their own discretion to decide which flights are canceled to satisfy the order, which does not require a reduction in international flights.
